items.name: fruitNetCNN
items.description: LeScapeNetCNN is an app that uses a vanilla JS/HTML/CSS frontend and a Python backend built in Flask to classify images with an advanced CNN. The CNN is used with a costumized Tensorflow-model that is built from the ground up by the team.

items.name: class-incremental-learning-experiments-with-the-FruitNet-dataset
items.description: This project explores Class-Incremental Learning techniques to combat catastrophic forgetting in neural networks. Using the FruitNet dataset, it evaluates strategies like Fine-Tuning, Joint training, replay-based approach, EWC, and LwF, balancing plasticity and stability. Experiments are conducted with PyTorch and a ResNet-18 backbone.

items.name: Fruit-quality-detection
items.description: A deep learning-based approach to classify the healthiness of Indian fruits using the FruitNet dataset and InceptionResNetV2. This project leverages CNNs and transfer learning to enhance fruit quality assessment. 🚀🔍

items.name: FruitsugarAi
items.description: FruitSugar AI 🍎 — Non-destructive fruit sugar content estimation using deep learning. MobileNetV2 transfer learning achieves 99.68% accuracy on 14,700+ images (FruitNet dataset). Deployed as a real-time Streamlit app. Built with TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV & scikit-learn. Applications in health tech & agri-tech.
